+name: AFW C2 DROP winner fixture RED
+on:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - lab/afw-c2-source-20261117-drop-winner-fixtures
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+jobs:
+  c2-drop-winner-fixtures:
+    if: >-
+      github.repository == 'tokenizartinfo-ops/agent-friendly-web' &&
+      github.event_name == 'push' &&
+      github.ref == 'refs/heads/lab/afw-c2-source-20261117-drop-winner-fixtures' &&
+      github.run_attempt == 1 &&
+      github.event.head_commit.id == github.sha &&
+      github.event.head_commit.message == 'AFW-C2-DROP-WINNER-FIXTURES-ONEUSE-20261117'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 3
+    steps:
+      - name: Read the admitted head and its parent
+        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+          persist-credentials: false
+          fetch-depth: 2
+      - name: Use the fixed Node runtime
+        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
+        with:
+          node-version: '22.23.4'
+      - name: Exercise the unmarked positive model
+        id: red
+        shell: bash
+        run: node docs/superpowers/source-lab/c2-drop-winner-tools/fixtures/run-red.mjs
+      - name: Preserve only the exact RED receipt
+        if: ${{ failure() && steps.red.outcome == 'failure' && steps.red.outputs.receipt == 'expected-red' }}
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
+        with:
+          name: afw-c2-drop-winner-fixtures
+          path: output/drop-winner-fixtures.json
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 7
